name: El Prez
notes: Photo 1 is a printed food menu (Antojitos, Bowls & Salads) with clear prices and descriptions. Photos 2 and 3 are drink-only (margaritas, slushees, specialty cocktails, beer on tap, bottled beers) and were skipped per rules.

dishes.name: Chips & Pico
dishes.description: Fresh tortilla chips served with our house-made pico de gallo. Or substitute one of our other house-made salsas for no additional cost.

dishes.name: Salt & Pepper Calamari
dishes.description: Fresh seasoned calamari, hand-battered and fried to crispy perfection. Served with fried jalapeno slices, chipotle aioli and cilantro jalapeno aioli for dipping.

dishes.name: Ceviche De Pescado
dishes.description: Fresh atlantic cod infused with flavors straight from Mexico. Mixed with lime, avocado, red onion, habanero peppers and cilantro. Served with fresh, house-made tortilla chips.

dishes.name: Flautas
dishes.description: Six crispy flour tortillas stuffed with chicken tinga, cotija cheese, red onions and side of fire-roasted red salsa. Served on a bed of lettuce and topped with pico de gallo and sour cream.

dishes.name: Coconut Shrimp
dishes.description: Deep fried jumbo shrimp crusted with panko and coconut shavings. Served atop a bed of cilantro-lime rice with a sweet chili dipping sauce on the side.

dishes.name: Salsa Trio
dishes.description: Fresh house-made tortilla chips served with three house-made salsas: pineapple habanero, pico de gallo and fire-roasted red salsa.

dishes.name: Nachos
dishes.description: Fresh house-made tortilla chips topped with melted cheddar cheese, nacho cheese, black beans, pico de gallo, sour cream and avocado sauce and jalapeno slices.

dishes.name: Guacamole
dishes.description: Guacamole made fresh with ripe avocado, fresh lime juice, tomato, red onion and cilantro. Topped with cotija cheese and cilantro. Served with house-made tortilla chips.

dishes.name: El Prez Guac
dishes.description: Guacamole made fresh with ripe avocado, red onion, cilantro, fresh lime juice, serrano peppers, parmigiano-reggiano and pomegranate pearls. Served with fresh, house-made tortilla chips.

dishes.name: Ahi Poke
dishes.description: Sushi-grade yellowfin tuna tossed with sesame soy dressing, cucumber, avocado, fresh jalapeno and black sesame seeds. Drizzled with sriracha-wasabi aioli, garnished with fresh scallions, served with salted flour bunuelos.

dishes.name: Queso Blanco Dip
dishes.description: A blend of melted Oaxaca and Asadero cheeses. Topped with house-made pico de gallo. Served in a cast iron skillet with a basket of fresh tortilla chips.

dishes.name: Caesar Presidential
dishes.description: Romaine lettuce drizzled with house-made Caesar dressing, topped with cherry tomatoes, avocado and shredded parmesan. Served with toasted crostinis.

dishes.name: Mixto Bowl
dishes.description: Chopped iceberg lettuce, fire-roasted corn, pico de gallo, black beans and cheddar cheese. Topped with avocado slices and a hard boiled egg, drizzled with cilantro-jalapeno ranch dressing. Served in a flour tortilla bowl.

dishes.name: La Huerta Salad
dishes.description: Mixed greens, strawberries, red onions, fried cauliflower and feta cheese tossed in a champagne vinaigrette.

dishes.name: Ahi Bowl
dishes.description: Seared, pepper-crusted ahi tuna served over a bed of mixed baby greens tossed in a wasabi soy vinaigrette. Topped with avocado, pineapple, scallions and crunchy peanuts.

dishes.name: De La Casa Bowl
dishes.description: Panko-crusted fried chicken, served on a bed of chopped romaine and iceberg lettuce with fire-roasted corn, black beans, crispy tortilla strips, cheddar cheese, avocado, jalapenos and cilantro. Tossed in cilantro jalapeno ranch dressing and served in a flour tortilla bowl.
